snippet.description:
Olympic weightlifting is defined by only two moves: the snatch and the clean and jerk. But behind what seems like a simple contest to see who can lift the most is a sport built on technique, speed, strategy, and psychology.

We speak to Matthew Tung, a competitive weightlifter who represents Hong Kong internationally, who breaks down how the lifts work, the strategy behind athletes changing their declared weights mid-competition, and how a lifter can miss four of their six attempts and still bring home gold.

In this video, we explore what it really takes to compete in Olympic weightlifting and what the rest of us can learn from athletes who have pushed strength training to the extreme.

Read more about professional weightlifting: 

Weightlifting in Olympics: Everything you need to know https://www.olympics.com/en/news/weightlifting-olympics-rules-history-snatch-clean-and-jerk

A Guide to Competitive Weightlifting
https://www.usaweightlifting.org/news/features/2022/july/29/a-guide-to-competitive-weightlifting 

Hong Kong’s first pro weightlifter in 12 years had to compete in tracksuit borrowed from footballer, learned to lift from YouTube
https://www.scmp.com/sport/other-sport/article/3253998/hong-kongs-first-pro-weightlifter-12-years-had-compete-tracksuit-borrowed-footballer-and-learned 

This Northeastern grad taught himself weightlifting and is now competing internationally
https://news.northeastern.edu/2024/09/10/international-weightlifting-competition-matthew-tung 

Unique aspects of competitive weightlifting: performance, training and physiology
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22873835/

snippet.description:
Welcome to Lecture 1 of the Mains Master Program (MMP) 2027 and Ethics Crash Course 2027 by LevelUp IAS.

In this session, Atul Garg Sir, Ethics Faculty at LevelUp IAS and one of the most recognised educators for UPSC CSE GS Paper IV: Ethics, Integrity & Aptitude, begins the journey towards mastering Ethics for UPSC Mains 2027.

Enrollment Open in Mains Master Program (MMP) 2027: https://shorturl.at/KMn2Y
Ethics Crash Course 2027: https://shorturl.at/rAfFb
📲Queries? Call directly- 8826496658

🔍Get a FREE 1-to-1 Mentorship Session with real teachers and senior mentors: https://shorturl.at/uBnu0

Meet us 📍 at LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/NvPyzytSwDQYEu8PA
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐔𝐬 
👉For regular current affairs updates from Santosh sir, join the Telegram Channel: https://t.me/Santoshkumarcurrentaffairs 
👉For regular course updates, visit our Telegram Channel: https://t.me/levelupias  
👉For important updates, visit our Instagram:
* https://www.instagram.com/levelupiasedutech/    
* https://www.instagram.com/currentaffairs_levelupias/

Atul Garg Sir has been teaching UPSC Ethics since GS Paper IV was introduced in 2013 and is also an author of books on Ethics for Civil Services preparation.

In this course, aspirants will work on:

✓ Complete coverage of the UPSC GS Paper 4 Ethics syllabus
✓ Conceptual clarity in Ethics, Integrity & Aptitude
✓ Understanding Ethics through UPSC-oriented questions
✓ Section-A answer writing
✓ Ethics case study approach and practice
✓ Integration of current affairs, examples and real-life illustrations
✓ Developing structured, practical and high-quality Ethics answers

The Ethics Crash Course for UPSC Mains 2027 is designed to move beyond simply memorising definitions and help aspirants understand how ethical concepts are actually applied in UPSC questions and case studies.

This session is also part of the LevelUp IAS Mains Master Program 2027, a structured Mains preparation program covering GS I–IV and Essay.

For course details and admissions, visit the official LevelUp IAS website.
